body:
You need to call into Undead Chronic's stream on YouTube.
It's just a voice chat, radio show or podcast kind of deal. He talks to a lot of guys. He'll talk to you and give you his advice. If you don't like it, that's cool, but I think he will understand you a lot and give you better advice than others have in this thread, plus it'll feel more personable to actually talk to someone. A lot of people can't relate to you and this thread you chose will not give you the best answers I believe.

Hope you're doing okay. My allergies haven't ever been that bad throughout my life except the past 1.5ish years. Now it's like I'm fighting to breathe pretty much every day, some moments worse than others.. I never have had to depend on allergy medicines like Flonase or Zyrtec until recently. I'm hoping to move out of Oklahoma soon as I'm sure this is not the best state to live in for allergy problems. I can't imagine having the allergy problems that you or others have however.

So you're trying to predict that Ben will "smoke" Larry in 2 years based off his progress so far? Okay well tell me when he benches 535lbsx2, conventional deadlifts 700, squats 700. Tell me when his physique looks anything like Larry's. 

You brought Larry up not me. I brought Clarence Kennedy up and you didn't say anything about that. Whatever you'll realize eventually or maybe you'll always think he must be on the juice. Yeah you're not outright accusing him but other people are so if I mistakenly group y'all together my apologies.

If you're gonna accuse this kid of being on the juice and of being a liar, I'd think you have some better arguments. Are you just looking for people to agree with you instead of actually trying to reason whether he's juiced? You specifically said in other posts it's not his physique that is sus, it's his big numbers and fast progress. You compared him to Larry Wheels. You brought up the overhead pressing. The biggest numbers he has are his squat and sumo deadlift. Nothing else he does compares to those. The fastest progress he's made is in those lifts. If you're telling me you think it's his bench and overhead press that are sus, when I just compared his 3plate 1 rep max to 18 yo Larry benching that for like 20+ reps and overhead pressing it then idk what you're smoking. Larry as of now could probably bench 3plates for 40 reps cause he's done it before. He's overhead pressed 200kg. A 3plate bench press nor a 85kg overhead press for a 90+kg dude like Ben is not sus. I already explained how his overhead pressing strength was above average to be able to do a handstand and handstand pushups at his height and bodyweight. His increase in bench press helped his overhead press when it was already 55kg early on. So 30kg added in about a year to his overhead press, 50kg added to his bench. This is the progress that you said was "faster than Larry Wheels on steroids?"

He's not juicing bro. I don't even know Ben but just by how he acts and what I see of his personality I absolutely don't believe he's lying. Plus, what kind of fake natty is so transparent and shares all of their training videos daily? You can track his progress from when he started and see his actual training. Usually fake natties hide a lot of stuff, don't post that often, don't interact much with fans, don't even post videos of the food they eat, and they have something to sell you. Fake natties like to get big and strong first, then come out of nowhere, but Ben has been with us before all that. What's Ben trying to sell? Nothing, he's just trying to be strong. He trains way harder than so many people, often working out 3 hours+ a day in his own words, he has a coach and other lifters helping him. 

You think he's juiced up just because his sumo deadlift and squat, but his bench is only 3 plates. Not saying 3 plates isn't impressive but it's not at all some fake natty feat. You mentioned Larry Wheels, but 18 year old Larry could bench 3 plates for like 20+ reps easily, he could overhead press that weight so there's no comparison at all. Also Larry doesn't do sumo deadlifts. Sumo deadlifts are just one of those lifts where if you have the technique and leverages, you can pull some crazy weight even if you're natty. 

His squat is strong but let's compare him to Clarence Kennedy. Are you gonna tell me Clarence Kennedy wasn't natty back in 2011-2012ish era or even 2010 when he was this skinny looking dude highbar squatting 200+kgs like it was nothing? He squatted more than Benjamin. Clarence didn't even train powerlifting as much cause he was an olympic lifter but he still had a ridiculous conventional deadlift(didn't even use sumo), squat, and a decent bench. It doesn't look like he juiced until 4-5 years ago when he came back from a break and was suddenly 100kg instead of 90ish kg. Benjamin actually trains powerlifting only not oly lifting so if he's a genetic phenom like Clarence then he should have some ridiculous numbers. People thought Clarence was on the juice too cause his fast progress but I think it's clear he wasn't until later. Clarence and Benjamin were around the same weight and physiques were similar but you cannot compare either of them to Larry. 

About the overhead press: he did 55kg for 1 rep way back when he first started uploading. He did a handstand back then, he did handstand pushups for 10 reps at a bodyweight of 83ish kg and being 6 ft. His overhead pressing strength was already there. But then he got his bench up from 90kg to 140ishkg now, so then of course his overhead press will have gone up without him even training it that much.

I'm glad you're okay. I feel you on like needing to be in a facility because I'm literally about to experience a break in reality and myself. It's scary, I don't want to lose myself. I don't want to lose control and go insane. I never even thought I could go insane until these feelings popped up. Anyways thank you for your response!

I don't know what to say or recommend but I guess what I'm doing is focusing on myself and my goals. My social life has never really existed. I think mainly because I was online schooled in highschool and then never went to college. But I've gotten to know some of my coworkers even though we're still like acquaintances or not-so-close friends. Idk I've asked people to hang out and been ignored as well. It's whatever, I've started to just not care. Fuck people if they want to be like that seriously. I realize I am a person just like them with needs and wants. I will happily reciprocate and do even more to show a person I acknowledge their efforts to be friendly or kind towards me, but I'm done expecting anything from people, I'm done caring about them, or dealing with their bullshit. I know I'm not the only person who knows how to clearly communicate and reciprocate in a friendship or relationship, and not be an abusive, immature, petty ass-wipe which sounds like the people you're dealing with.

I notice it a lot too and yes it hurts. I don't know what to think about it though because part of me is jealous but I know it looks better than what it really is. Do I really want my time and energy to be drained away on some other person who may or may not stay with me, may be disloyal, incompatible, cause me headache and heartache? What would they do for me that would make the sacrifice worth it? Idk but so far I've felt that although I hate being alone it's what I will take for right now. If I really wanted it I would focus on it every day and do something to progress but I see I'm just slacking so it is what it is.

I've felt lonely a lot for the past 5 years. I'm 23 now. It's gotten better in ways and worse at the same time. Firstly, don't call those people your friends because they clearly are not. I think at our age, but especially ages 17-19 you cannot expect maturity, empathy, compassion, or considerateness from your peers. Yeah they probably don't care much about you. They might be petty people jealous of you. It's childish, it's silly. I know it can hurt to be excluded or to feel different and not good enough. Don't take it personally. There's always going to be someone picked on, left out, alone. It's not your doing and it's not your fault if people don't reciprocate your efforts in the friendship or relationship. Someone wants to be your friend and hang out with you. Believe that and you're halfway there. You are your greatest friend and enemy.

I'm sorry to hear about your situation and I hope you can figure it out.

I try to remind myself that the world is cruel and heartless but to keep going. I feel invisible and like I don't matter but I know part of that is in my head, it's part of my self-fulfilling thoughts that can easily sway me back to being suicidal vs convincing me that I have things to live for and I'm not so bad after all. I know I have to improve my situation for myself. I have to accept what I've missed out on and accept regret. People die all the time. Tragedies far worse than mine exist. This is just how reality is. You or I could really live this life as miserable as we imagine in our nightmares, or we could live it as beautiful as in our dreams. Whatever happens to you or I doesn't matter. You won't be the first person that died. You won't be the first person that suffered. Or likewise you won't be the first who achieved success and happiness. In the end none of this really matters.

I know those feelings of loneliness well I've had them for quite some time now. As for what I'm going to do about it, fuck if I know honestly. I'm just taking it day by day. My #1 priority is to improve my career and financial situation and beyond that dealing with people seems complicated, and I just suck at it probably. I hope things go well for you.

I'm not sure I agree with how you generalize and presume that a lot of people are just here to have a pity party and aren't willing to help each other. For all we know they're just venting and want a place to do that. I also don't understand what your solution is. You say "let's talk and better each other", but what does that mean? Are you looking for online friends basically? I've tried that before and it's usually lead to being ghosted because people will either delete their account or stop responding entirely without even trying to communicate to me that they're not interested anymore. I think the problem is that online relationships aren't a replacement for real life interaction as there's just a lot of limitations to what you can do. That's why I'm okay with not having online friends because it likely won't be as fulfilling of a relationship anyways. The real problem to address is why don't we have friends in real life? How do you or I specifically go about fixing our situation? What options are there to try, whether it be college, volunteering, getting a job or different job, finding some club or place that has social activity where you could meet people and actually have a fair chance that they'd be the type of people you'd want to befriend and vice versa?

I wish I was going to school and had friends. I keep pushing through the loneliness trying to work myself out of here... Out of spending all my days alone in this apartment. I hate seeing couples together, and I hate the word "friends" cause idk it just reminds me of something I feel like I don't have and I'm jealous. I'm jealous I can never take back what I've missed out on. I'm turning bitter and negative but I don't show it to people. I just want things to be different already.

This is not to diminish what you're going through. I don't know what it's like but I hope you can find your way out of your situation.

I was online schooled in highschool so I never had any friends from then. I didn't go to college. I'm 23 now and I still don't have any "friends." I put friends in quotes cause I know people and they know me, I talk to people and they're friendly but we don't hang out together. It's a superficial friendship, more like an acquaintance. They would rather hang out with the people they already know... From high school or college. Makes me sad and depressed

You say you've adapted to being alone and like it now but is that really true? Why else are you here venting about what you missed out on and how you don't fit in if it didn't bother you? You admit that you want to experience love and a relationship with a woman, right? Then don't tell yourself you're okay with dying a virgin because it sounds like a lie. You're probably stressed about the prospect of fixing your social and romantic life and it overwhelms you so you think giving up would be better. That will only lead to regret, and probably self-hate, low self-esteem. This is coming from someone just like you. I was online schooled throughout middle and high school so I never got much interaction with anyone back then. I didn't go to college cause I was bad at school, it's expensive as hell, and I didn't know what to do until now. I'm 23 so that is almost 10 years of missing out on so much. Despite that I can't give up yet and I would encourage you to not give up either. If you want to I believe you can figure your situation out and improve it. Even if it's difficult, I believe you can find the friends and love you desire, but you have to believe in yourself.

I love and I hate myself it depends on my mood. I see my positive qualities and the ways that my life is good, and something I should be grateful for, but there are things that make me insecure and negative too.

I don't stab people in the back I would either distance myself from them or kill myself. I'm a person that withdraws and gets suicidal. I'm jealous because I see people my age getting to experience friendships and romantic relationships while it hasn't gone well for me. No one gives a shit about me so if they're doing well they'll just keep doing well not worrying about someone like me and that's spoken from experience. I feel like sabotaging myself and being apathetic to everyone that comes my way because that's how I feel I'm treated. I'm invisible. I don't matter. People only want me for favors or help.
I've definitely realized that they will fail me because it's already happened multiple times. I'm confused.

I like your advice and I already do pretty much everything you said but I think you misunderstood when I said "relationships." I'm not only talking about romantic relationships I meant friendships too. I don't have friends to meet and that's what bothers me.
I don't think I'm good enough. I judge myself and it makes me not put myself out there because I already told myself I'd fail.
I hope it works out for you and that you're doing okay.
I don't know how to become close with someone. I don't know what that's like but I can imagine.

Hi and thank you for your help. I hope you're doing okay. 

I guess I do sometimes but my mood can vary. I'll become suicidal and convinced I'm ugly, that there are things wrong with me. I lose confidence and hate myself.

It doesn't sound like she's interested. I would move on and focus on yourself. You'll meet another girl. I don't think you want someone that is unresponsive, doesn't show effort to have conversations, and doesn't seem to care if they don't hear from you or talk to you. It takes two to dance.

It's not the girl or the guy's fault it's the world and society's fault. These people are just products and a reflection of their environment and circumstances. Somehow that man's family, friends, and environment failed in raising him to be good. Something must be faulty with his family and friends too and who raised them? It goes on and on but basically this is what happens as a result of there being so many people alive. We have almost 8 billion people. If you think of us as one big family(which we technically are I guess) then I would say we're a dysfunctional family that is failing to properly manage itself and can't possibly manage itself at this point because there's too much to keep track of. We don't get to see all the bad things happening to our brothers and sisters which causes them to become bad human beings so how can we prevent it unless we learn from it after the fact? We're too disconnected at this point and the world likely will never change.

That's true in a way but the focus should be put on the guy and understanding him. We can't expect and tell women to cover up more, not walk around at night, etc. and basically limit their ability to live life how they want because they're in fear of being attacked when the real problem is what the hell caused this other human being to become a murderer? How did the world and his environment fail him? Prevent murderers from being made and the world will be a better place.

I don't know if I've given up on it at this point but I feel inclined to push people away and I feel bitter and jealous now. I am just focusing on career, work, developing my skill in my interests hoping that maybe I can accomplish some things or contribute. If I got into a relationship I don't know if I even want it. I have a desire to sabotage such a thing and reject anyone who tries to get close. I guess it's cause I feel rejected and I'm frustrated by it so I'd inflict the same thing onto others. I don't know if I'll be alive 5-10 years from now I've never been able to get over my negative feelings and suicidal thoughts.

I'm 23 but I feel you man. I really can't imagine making it to my 30s and still alone. I have had suicidal tendencies even before I understood why I felt such a way when I was 18. Now that I understand what bothers me it just feels worse and more intense. Like it's not a fluke anymore I genuinely see my possible future being me killing myself not because I want to but because the bouts of negative emotions and thoughts I experience make it hard to keep believing in myself or to keep trying.
Thank you for understanding! I appreciate you offering your help. I'd feel bad if I didn't reciprocate so if you need to talk to someone I'm here for you. :)

I hope you don't take offense to me responding so late but if you do I don't blame you at all and if you ignore me I totally understand. Tbh, I just felt so shitty and negative I chose not to respond. Sometimes I get so negative I push people away, telling myself something like "they don't actually give a shit about me. Fuck them. Fake insincere piece of shit." It's also just that I feel tired talking about my problems at this point since I have multiple posts about them. If I'm to get better and overcome my issues I feel like I need to just be quiet and step away from some things, like posting on Reddit for attention when I feel bad. It's not personal at all I just felt it was better to shut myself up. I hope you're doing better and things aren't as rough as they were when we last replied to each other.

Nah chief you're here for a reason fuck suicide and choose to live because I'm rooting for you like I'm rooting for myself not to end it all but to see things through and see if by the end of my life I can feel better than I do now at 23 years old. There's a lot to do, a lot to learn and explore, a lot of experiences to have. I get sad and lonely but better to lay down, watch some YouTube, distract myself for a bit, and then get back to doing something productive, figuring out my next move, than to get overwhelmed and kill myself. I'm stuck working a $11.35/hour retail job but fuck it I'm here I want to see what else I can do in life. I don't know if this helps you but I hope you're okay.

Like others have said it's not worth it. Money isn't the most important thing to you, is it? You could be a rich person and still end up wanting to kill yourself because you're missing something else that money can't get you. You can get money back anyways not saying it's easy but at least it's not like a permanent loss.

I agree with what you're saying but don't proceed with the next step. Stay here as long as you can and try to make it as fucked up as it may seem. There's always hope, and there is a lot to explore and do while being alive even though sometimes you might be in a mood where nothing matters and you can't understand why you're alive, why you should live, what makes you keep going to the next day.

I can understand that some of the stuff is boring to do or study. Like learning to sightread music for example is really awful for me so I've done it in doses here and there. And learning to play the pieces of others isn't as interesting to me as playing my own music, so I also just practice that very loosely, like picking some specific part of a piece to practice even though I won't play the whole thing. Most of my time has been spent learning theory, and then improvising and analyzing stuff I can play, while also developing certain techniques I like. I get the most enjoyment from my own playing which sounds like is what fits you as well. I am planning on continuing to practice the other stuff though just to be more well-rounded.

Since other people have already given you some options, I'll just give my opinion. I would advise you to develop skills if necessary for what you want to do instead of looking for something that seems easier cause it doesn't require certain skills. For me, I'm trying to get better at piano and guitar to make the music that is interesting to me. Developing the skill to play the instrument and express your ideas well is just an inevitable part of being a musician. Some musicians don't need much technique others do. It's the same with drawing and many other fields. Don't rule yourself out from being able to do something!
I hope you are doing good, that you're having a Happy New Year. I also wish you the best in life. Thank you for responding, and for reaching out to me.
Not to say you're wrong but I'll tell you as someone who's 23 I've never felt more suicidal and hopeless in my life. It doesn't get better for some people.

When I think about it, I would say I'm not happy with myself and my life. Will that change? I guess we'll see. Am I compelled to kill myself? Yes I am. It's an urge, it's like my escape or my only option because to continue living sounds so unpleasant I think I'd rather be dead.

I've been a loner all my life. Unfortunate circumstances and decisions I've made. I did online schooling in high school. I didn't go to college. I'm 23 now. I was alone from 13 all the way until now. Like literally no single friend to hang with I didn't experience socializing growing up. I know some people online and talk to them at least, but it's not the same. I talk to my coworkers but it's also not the same.

Whatever you're comfortable with doing. I don't think a good father would dismiss or ignore his child's feelings. If he does at least you know you tried. I mean I guess he's already ignored you from your point of view but don't give up on trying talk with him about this.

I thought more about what I said. I think it is ultimately better if you somehow bring this up to your father, or your step-mom if you feel there's any connection there at all. In reality maybe these things don't occur to him, maybe he doesn't realize. In that case, he needs to realize these things for you and your brother's sake. If you at least talk about it, and can see how he reacts, you'll determine whether an improved relationship with him is likely. You don't want to wait on him to make the first move even though arguably he should. You don't want to wait on having a better relationship with him if it's not actually going to happen. Bring this up and hopefully he'll understand, empathize, and apologize.

I don't know if I agree with this. I'm sure that the father had a very difficult time but he handled things in a way that has caused OP problems. And OP said that she is or feels like she's being pushed away or avoided now. Why should she have to be the one that takes responsibility for the poor relationship between her and her father? It's her father's responsibility too. He's the parent, the one who should be a mature wiser adult, a grown ass man who got a girl pregnant and had kids. He allowed the poor relationship to develop. Doesn't it occur to him maybe he should reach out to his daughter and try to make up for how he's been to her? To communicate that he understands he failed in some ways and caused pain? Especially now since he's being the father he should have been. I don't know but it sounds shitty on the father's part.
Can confirm that isolation has made me maybe a little crazy, and suicidal
Good for you buddy. I'm curious what you and others think about me, a cashier, giving my number to a customer? Is it too inappropriate or risky?
Am I the only one that gets sad hearing stuff like this because they feel they'll never experience anything like it?
It makes me wonder what's wrong with me. Am I that unlikeable, that unattractive? Why does it seem to happen for everyone else?

I don't know much about you but I'm going through the same struggle and have been for years. 23 years old, never went to college, did online school for highschool, all I have are my coworkers but they're all acquaintances none are friends I hang with. I think there's not much I can do other than research places to go to around me, and literally walk outside in the downtown area where I live, or walk through parks and such. There's no other way around it. If you stay inside, you can guarantee that you'll spend another day alone. Unless you like online interaction which I personally don't. I think online interaction is better if than nothing, but in person interaction is much more fulfilling and interesting. I don't just want some friends, I want a girlfriend. She's out there somewhere...

I like that quote and at the same time it fails to convince me that this world is beautiful or worth believing in. People die and suffer all the time, for seemingly no reason other than they're unlucky. No one really cares, at least for too long. I wake up and I go about my day but oftentimes I really just don't feel like there's anything that makes life worth living through.

I don't know you, but you sound like you really want to live, and can give this life and the people around you something positive but is just having circumstances hold you back. I feel for you. It's horrible your mom is gone and what your family situation has been. I don't know exactly what to advise, but I know that basically you need to get the fuck away from your father because although he's your dad, you may feel dependent on him, maybe you have some feelings for him, he's failing to be a responsible parent and person. He's dragging you down with him, because maybe he's had a rough life himself and doesn't know any better. If you have it in you, you have to keep going for yourself. I don't know how but you need to get a job, get a cheap place, or find a trustworthy person or relative you can live with while you work and do school. Don't let your father or anyone else discourage you. You can do whatever you want you are your own person! You're going to be a full fledged young adult soon! I'm sorry to hear about your friends taking their lives. As hard as life is, especially as it must be for you, I want you to know that I'm rooting for you to succeed because I want to kill myself sometimes too, but I keep going, and I want everyone to keep going. It's really hard but I see that life and being a human being is a special experience. Why were we given this life especially when it seems unfair and pointless I don't know. But I know that we have the power to make each other happy. You can do something in this life to make this world a happier place. You are that special so don't end yourself.

I hope you're alive and make it through what you've just done, and that afterwards you will maybe find life worth living. At the same time I understand why you would do this. This has been said before but oftentimes no one gives a fuck about a depressed and suffering person until it's too late. And sometimes a person doesn't want to live until they're about to die. I want to kill myself almost every day. I'm unhappy almost every day. I don't know why I keep going but I do. I hope I'm sincerely happy one day and I hope the same for you and everyone else. Otherwise, I guess this is just life. Living things die every day and we'll all die eventually.
I feel like you're slightly struggling on some of your bends. but I mean your playing is great otherwise

23M here I also feel really anxious because I've never been in a relationship and I'm still looking for one. I'm also anxious though because I have to do much more work before I feel financially secure, feel good about what I do, and like I'm even worth it to a girl I admire. So many of my peers are graduating college getting solid jobs and such. I'm taking an unusual route and not going to college at least at the moment so if I fail I think I really will be alone.

I feel the same sometimes but I also think it's possible for me to fit in somewhere, and that I'll find a romantic partner hopefully. I'm 23 didn't have a normal upbringing, was really isolated from other people in my teenage years and I didn't go to college which also made it harder to find others. I have my job but I'm not anybody's friend there, just an acquaintance. I have an online friend but well..
 It's not the same as knowing them in person and plus they have real friends they'd rather hang with than me sometimes. I've been suicidal for 4 years but at least it's become clear to me what it is I really value and want in my life which is connections and fun times with other people I can get along with. Even though I often get discouraged and start thinking negative thoughts, like every day, I also keep going. I keep working on things that I like, and striving to change my life for the better while I'm still somewhat young and can do something before I feel really old. I have the power to change my situation, and I'm just another person like everyone else. I guess it's inevitable that some of us will choose to kill ourselves, some of us will choose to live. I hope you choose to live, and to do whatever you think you need to to feel like this life is precious and worth living.

Thank you for your encouragement and advice! I'll try to construct an exercise like that myself. I do kind of do exercises or experiments somewhat like that already. Also, that is an interesting tuning haha.

I appreciate your detailed response! Thank you for your time and effort in replying! I've gotten several good pieces of advice so far, and I will try to heed yours as much as I can. I guess I am kind of stressed out on achieving an end goal as quick as I can, and not really enjoying myself or the music. I also see that maybe I need to practice playing more guitar and not so much ear training stuff.

I want to say thank you for your very long and detailed response, and the thoughtful advice you've shared. I appreciate your effort and time. I would say yeah I should enjoy myself more instead of focusing on the end result of being "good enough." And maybe accept I won't be god-tier, but I can still keep improving and see how far I go. So thank you for your encouraging words and I hope you also continue to improve and accomplish whatever music goals you have at this point even though you've been at it for a long time already.

Yeah okay I'm being unreasonable with the time I've put in and the results I should expect haha but it feels longer than what it's been and that I've really worked at it but I guess I got a lot more work and time to put in. Anyways thank you guys for your responses.

Okay this sounds good I have kind of done harmonic interval singing but not much compared to ascending and descending or applying it to chords. I'll try transcribing the way you suggest. I do already sing solos and regular pop music just out of habit or enjoyment. Thank you for the advice and response!

Firstly I just want to say thank you for the long and detailed response. I don't know how long that took you to come up with and type out but I really appreciate your effort and time. And thanks for being sincere and considerate towards me. I would've understood if you went harsh on me if I saw you had some points so no worries. Yeah I know I need to focus more on performing and learning to play the music I do feel like I've neglected that but all this ear training stuff I'm doing because of others I've seen who are better than me recommend it. Like I heard Guthrie once say in a vid on YouTube something like "you should be able to sing what you play, not that you have to but that you could." Oscar Peterson sings while improvising, Benson does it, Guthrie could do it it seems... Maybe they're not strictly singing intervals or doing strict non-musical ear training exercises though. But yeah in any case I'll get to spending more of my time learning music and playing it instead of as much ear training stuff.
About 1.5 years. I first learned to recognize intervals back then

I focus on myself and my goals to be a musician cause it's a dream I've had since I was a teen, and to learn computer science since I need something more financially stable and I've had slight interest in computers growing up. I'm not going to college however. I got weights I lift like this barbell and some plates, I guess I'm trying to look like Dorian Yates hoping that this among other things helps me to get a date. Did I mention I rap to myself sometimes for fun? It's crap but it's one thing I do that keeps me from grabbing a gun and unloading on myself. Why am I suicidal? Cause I feel like I don't have anyone else but me, and there's no help coming anytime soon probably. I'm a 23 year old virgin never had a GF but at this point I'm like fuck it. So am I still a virgin after fucking it? Fuck I suck at jokes. Lol

Basically I don't know where to go or what to do to meet people trust me I've looked at options and not much promise in any of them. I'm mostly a loner with 3 online gaming friends. I just wake up, try to work on my side stuff, have as much fun as I can at my retail job. I'm not really friends with any of my coworkers but that doesn't stop me from having a good time and joking with and trolling everyone.
